entities.name: Jaroslav Krejčí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav Krejčí was a Czech lawyer and Nazi collaborator. He served as the prime minister of the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia from 28 September 1941 to 19 January 1945. After the war, Krejčí was sentenced to a 25-year prison term and subsequently died while in prison.
